Chart timestamps are displayed in the browser's local timezone, even though the database stores Unix seconds (UTC-based).


---

</details>
</tool-use>

---



---

Timestamps are stored in the database as Unix timestamps (seconds since epoch, UTC). They’re displayed in the browser’s local timezone.

- In `chart_support.js` (lines 117-129), `formatTime()` uses `Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, ...)`. When the locale is `undefined`, the browser applies the local timezone.
- In `alerts.html` (line 108), `formatTimestamp()` uses `toLocaleString()` with no arguments, again using the browser’s local timezone.

So the times shown vary by the viewer’s timezone and may not include a timezone label.
